description: Single source of truth for the acceptance floor of SCORING.md section 1.5 in this repository. Read by governance/tools/checker.py.

floor.statement: A governed source is accepted only with a completed score (every gate graded, composite = weakest gate, score_token = level + composite) at L4 or L5 and composite grade D or better, bound to the SHA-256 of its exact bytes. Sources in governance/baseline.json with unchanged bytes are grandfathered.

support_categories.name: test
support_categories.reason: Test modules are verification harnesses, not production code. They keep a completed score, grade D or better and every integrity check, but are not held to capability level L4.

pinned_boilerplate.reason: Empty package markers (zero bytes). They hold no code, so there is nothing to score; only the exact empty file is admitted, as with the sibling repository's pinned build hook.

not_yet_governed.reason: Imported trees. The maintainer approved bringing them in on 2026-10-26; they join the population (Python, Rust, Lean 4) with a baseline of their exact bytes once the rename of private names lands. PFP Lab does not import them.
